verdict.rationale: cubic's documented chat lives in its own web PR interface (chat sidebar, 'Add to AI chat'), not inside the developer's IDE. Its IDE-adjacent offerings are a CLI and an MCP server that feeds a third-party coding agent; that chat belongs to the other agent, not to cubic. No cubic IDE extension or in-IDE chat is evidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can chat with the coding assistant directly inside my IDE for contextual help
